title: Lightly Oiled Chinese Bok Choi Bao
description: A fresh, light, and festive Chinese dish featuring bok choi, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is dairy-free-friendly and can be prepared in under 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: Rice Flour Bao Buns
ingredients.notes: You can find these in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.notes: Use a light oil for a delicate flavor

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced and sautéed for added flavor

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Grated and sautéed for added warmth

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a light soy sauce for a delicate flavor

ingredients.name: Hoisin Sauce
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds a sweet and savory flavor

ingredients.name: Sesame Oil
ingredients.notes: Used for added fragrance and flavor

ingredients.name: Cornstarch
ingredients.notes: Used as a slurry to thicken the sauce

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and sauté for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the chopped bok choi and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Add the soy sauce mixture to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional minute.
To assemble the bao, place a few leaves of bok choi in the bottom of each bao bun.
Add a few tablespoons of the stir-fried bok choi on top of the leaves.
Drizzle the lightly oiled bok choi with the soy sauce mixture and garnish with chopped scallions.
